stories.title: Nvidia doubles revenue as board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang
summary: Company issues first earnings report after ouster of CEO over allegations of affair with suspected Chinese spyNvidia “does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO”, the chairman of the company’s board said Tuesday.

Harvey Jones made the remark during Nvidia’s first quarterly earnings report since Jensen Huang’s ouster.Nvidia announced the same day that its quarterly revenue beat expectations, coming in at $115.84bn, doubling from the same time period a year ago.

The third-quarter earnings report comes just days after the world’s most valuable chip company saw the ouster of Huang over allegations of several extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy and two with his own employees.
